scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: Build a reliable alerts pipeline
scenes.caption: Kabir designs an offline workflow for synthetic service-alert records. Each record has a stable ID, category and priority score from zero to one hundred. The exercise routes scores at least seventy to human review; lower valid scores are recorded only.
scenes.dialogue: A pipeline needs clear contracts between steps.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Not every input is valid
scenes.caption: The pack includes an out-of-range score and an unknown category. Silently dropping those rows would make the output look complete while hiding lost evidence. The original batch must remain available for review and repair.
scenes.dialogue: Invalid input needs a visible route.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Four connected stages
scenes.caption: Preserve the original input, validate the schema and stable IDs, transform valid records, then commit a retry-safe output ledger and action log. Quarantine malformed or conflicting records without inventing values or overwriting originals.
scenes.dialogue: Each stage states what it receives and produces.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose the invalid-record path
scenes.caption: Should an invalid score be silently changed to zero, deleted from the evidence, or held in a labelled quarantine while valid records follow the stated contract?
scenes.dialogue: A convenient output must not hide an invalid input.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: A traceable pipeline run
scenes.caption: Kabir records valid outputs and the reason each invalid input was quarantined. The ledger remembers committed event IDs so a retry can distinguish an already handled event from a conflicting reuse of that ID. This is a classroom model, not a distributed delivery guarantee.
scenes.dialogue: Record both success and unresolved work.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the pipeline lab
scenes.caption: Arrange the stages, specify their input and output contracts and run the mixed-validity pack. Nothing is sent to a real service or person; review routes stay inside the lesson.
scenes.dialogue: Make failure paths part of the design.
